degree_rationale: Two Mysteries: Sun and Moon as visible mysteries of light — the sun in three types (undiminished disc, exalted light, exalted height) showing forth the First Greatness; the night as visible mystery of darkness. Completed sign-system of light.
direction_rationale: The luminaries as ultimate visible mysteries — settled signs of the Father's hiddenness and exaltation. West = visible-completed mystery.
grand_man_function: Spiritual mystery-of-luminaries — the daily-visible seal of celestial truth.
title: The Two Mysteries: Sun and Moon as visible mysteries of light
